results.title: WestJet flight attendants go on strike after talks fall through, grounding flights
results.description: WestJet flight attendants commenced a strike on Sunday after contract negotiations failed. The Canadian Union of Public Employees represents thousands of affected cabin crew members. This action highlights broader efforts by flight attendants seeking better compensation structures. WestJet confirmed the work stoppage and will refund or re-accommodate affected passengers.

results.title: Brad Pitt’s French château winery comes under risk after wildfires
results.description: Wildfires are currently burning near Brad Pitt's French Château Miraval estate. Firefighters successfully used water from the property's private lake to combat the blaze. Meanwhile, George and Amal Clooney evacuated their Provence home due to the extreme heat wave. Brad Pitt and Angelina Jolie continue their decade-long legal dispute over the estate. The former couple's fight for Château Miraval persists after their separation.
